segments.ja70:1.1: Na taṃ jitaṃ sādhu jitaṃ, yaṃ jitaṃ avajīyati;
segments.ja70:1.3: Taṃ kho jitaṃ sādhu jitaṃ, yaṃ jitaṃ nāvajīyatīti.
segments.ja70:4.1: Sikhīsabbaghasopi ca vīṇavaro, pisuṇā mittabhedikā nandī nadī;
segments.ja70:4.3: Mudulakkhaṇa sodariyā ca mano, visa sādhujitena bhavanti dasāti.
